# Security policy — unofficial Mac fork

This source-only community fork is maintained on a best-effort basis by @yosoro114514. There is no guaranteed response time or support SLA.

Please report security issues privately using [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/yosoro114514/VideoCull-Mac/security/advisories/new). Do not put exploit details, private media, personal paths or credentials in public issues. If private reporting is unavailable, open a minimal issue asking for a private contact channel without disclosing the vulnerability.

Relevant issues include unsafe file deletion/path handling, Electron IPC isolation, malicious-media handling and build dependency integrity. Test only with data and systems you own or have permission to test. Use synthetic or redacted examples where possible.

This is not the upstream project's security policy. Issues affecting upstream should be coordinated with its maintainers after assessment; reporting here does not automatically notify them. For ordinary bugs, use [this fork's Issues](https://github.com/yosoro114514/VideoCull-Mac/issues).
